panels.description: The cotton bale bumps against the closed warehouse shutter. Dust settles around it; only the lower edge of the unfinished sign is visible. Keep lower-right metal clear for lettering.

Baba Tau, a wiry elderly man in a dusty shawl and faded wool cap, sits at the mandi-gate chai stall holding his chipped glass. The warehouse is small but centered behind him. Keep the top-left open for a caption.
Baba Tau looks toward the warehouse as a railway horn and mandi activity begin. Keep upper-left negative space for narration.

The shutter lifts only a narrow amount. Inside the dark warehouse, the oversized English z of GODARAZ appears first, twice the height of every other letter, with four lane silhouettes and festoon lights behind it. Keep upper-right darkness clear for lettering.

items.text: In Hanumangarh, every story begins with a thing that has already been moving.
This one concerns a man for his time and place.
